page_title: MAI 2-0 AUG | Mainz v Augsburg 07/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Paul Nebel (Mainz) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
90+5' Stefan Bell (Mainz) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Finn Dahmen is alert and denies him with a nice save.
90+4' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Patrick Ittrich who sees an offensive foul.
90+2' That's a clear yellow card. Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) goes into the book.
90+2' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 11:10.

90+1' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' None of the Mainz players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
88' Urs Fischer decides to make a substitution. Jae-Sung Lee will be replaced by Lennard Maloney (Mainz).
88' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
83' The game is interrupted as Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) is flagged offside.
81' Silvan Widmer will be replaced by Phillipp Mwene (Mainz).
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Paul Nebel (Mainz) will replace Nadiem Amiri.
81' Urs Fischer has decided to substitute Dominik Kohr and he is replaced by Kacper Potulski (Mainz).
81' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) gets a yellow card. The referee Patrick Ittrich made the right call.
81' Manuel Baum prepares a substitution. Robin Fellhauer is replaced by Fabian Rieder (Augsburg).
80' 2 - 0 Goal! Finn Dahmen gets a hand on the penalty from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
79' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is going to take the penalty!
78' Yellow card. Anton Kade (Augsburg) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.

78' Referee Patrick Ittrich sees the trip by Anton Kade (Augsburg) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. PENALTY to Mainz! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
78' A cross from a corner kick by Augsburg is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

77' Ismael Gharbi (Augsburg) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Daniel Batz, who makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
71' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
71' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his own player gets in the way and blocks it.
70' Ball possession – 42:58.
68' The linesman signals that Phillip Tietz (Mainz) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
66' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
66' The referee blows his whistle as Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) was too aggressive in his challenge.
63' Here is a change. Silas is going off and Urs Fischer gives the last tactical orders to Sheraldo Becker (Mainz).
62' The ball is cleared after Silas (Mainz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
60' The main referee, Patrick Ittrich, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) is given a yellow card for dissent.
57' A substitution has been made. Marius Wolf goes off and Anton Kade (Augsburg) comes on.
57' Manuel Baum has decided to make a change. Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) replaces Elvis Rexhbecaj.
57' Substitution. Michael Gregoritsch will be replaced by Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg).
55' Danny da Costa (Mainz) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
53' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
52' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Corner kick. Mainz will have an opportunity.
50' A cross into the box from Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) is cleared.
50' Silas (Mainz) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the right side of the goal is far too weak and Finn Dahmen makes a simple save.
47' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
46' The game has come to an end for Noahkai Banks. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' A header by Silas (Mainz) from very close range goes towards the middle of the target, but doesn't get past Finn Dahmen, who makes a nice save.

45+3' Silas (Mainz) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
45+2' Stefan Posch (Mainz) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' A snap shot by Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Finn Dahmen produces a good save to thwart him.
43' Danny da Costa (Mainz) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
39' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Silas (Mainz) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
36' Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle and it's Phillip Tietz (Mainz) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
35' The referee awards a corner and Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) goes over to take it.
34' Arthur Chaves (Augsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
30' Patrick Ittrich has a clear sight and sees a foul from Arthur Chaves (Augsburg).
27' Silas (Mainz) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
27' A corner kick by Augsburg is thwarted by the well prepared Daniel Batz (Mainz).
26' Mert Komur (Augsburg) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save.
23' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
22' Total attempts – 1:4.
19' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

19' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Daniel Batz stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal. Augsburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
19' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
14' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Mert Komur (Augsburg), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way.
13' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
12' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) commits a rough foul. Patrick Ittrich stops the game and makes a call.
10' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

10' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Daniel Batz thwarts him with a great two-handed save. Augsburg get a corner.
8' 1 - 0 Goal! Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Finn Dahmen into the bottom right corner.
8' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
5' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Mainz.
3' Augsburg are ruled offside.
3' Stefan Bell (Mainz) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Mainz will take the kick-off.
Patrick Ittrich will supervise the game today.
